title: How to Clean a Range Hood

seo.title: How to Clean a Range Hood
seo.meta_description: Clean a range hood by degreasing the exterior and the correct filter type without soaking the motor or controls, then dry parts completely before reinstalling.
seo.search_intent: Clean a kitchen range hood by separating housing, filters, and electrical components so grease is removed without damaging the appliance.

excerpt: Range-hood grease collects on the underside, edges, and filters where it may not be obvious. Before soaking anything, determine whether the filter is washable metal or a replaceable charcoal type.
content_html:
Turn the hood off and let the cooking area cool. Separate washable parts from electrical parts: the housing, filters, motor, and controls do not get the same treatment.

Start with the exterior and underside

Remove dust, then grease using a cleaner compatible with stainless steel, paint, or glass. Apply cleaner to the cloth near switches, lights, and seams instead of spraying into openings.

Identify the filter

Metal mesh grease filters are often washable. Many charcoal filters in recirculating hoods are consumable and must be replaced. Check the manual before putting any filter in a dishwasher.

Degrease a metal filter gradually

Soak it in hot water with a compatible detergent and brush gently. For heavy buildup, repeat rather than combining aggressive chemicals.

Do not spray the motor or electrical cavity

Visible grease near the fan does not make internal soaking safe. Deep buildup that the manual does not make accessible is a service-level cleaning task.

Dry completely before reinstalling

A wet filter carries moisture and residue back into the hood. Reinstall it securely and confirm normal airflow afterward.

Cleaning before the filter becomes saturated keeps grease from migrating deeper and helps the hood move air effectively.

faq.question: Can the grease filter go in the dishwasher?
faq.answer: Only when the hood manufacturer permits it; some metal finishes can discolor or degrade.

faq.question: Are charcoal filters washable?
faq.answer: Many are replacement items rather than washable filters. Check the model instructions.

faq.question: Can I spray degreaser inside the hood?
faq.answer: Not onto the motor, wiring, or controls. Apply product to a cloth around electrical areas.
